memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he went to, and his descendants will inherit it. Since the Amalekites and the Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea." — Num 14:24-25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
In the middle of a chapter full of judgment, one man is singled out for honour. God says of Caleb, "he has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly." While an entire generation lost the promise through unbelief, Caleb would receive it in full — he and his descendants after him.

What made Caleb different? A "different spirit." He looked at the same giants, faced the same fears, heard the same fearful crowd — yet something in him chose to trust God fully. His faith was not half-hearted or hesitant. He followed God "wholeheartedly," holding nothing back.

This is a beautiful encouragement. In a world, a workplace, even a church that has given in to fear and unbelief, one person of wholehearted faith stands out to God and is not forgotten. You may feel surrounded by discouragement and compromise. But God sees the one who quietly, fully trusts Him, and He honours such faith.

The phrase "follows me wholeheartedly" is worth holding onto. God is not looking for perfection but for wholeheartedness — a heart that leans on Him without reservation. In Christ, we are given new hearts and His own Spirit to enable exactly this kind of following. Whatever the crowd around you does, resolve to be a Caleb: a person of a different spirit, who follows God with everything. Such faith is always seen and always honoured by the God who rewards those who diligently seek Him.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Would God describe you as one who follows Him wholeheartedly?
2. What holds you back from fuller, more reserved-free trust in God?
3. How does having a "different spirit" set you apart in your own setting?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, give me the different spirit of Caleb — a heart that follows You wholeheartedly, holding nothing back. In a world of compromise and fear, help me to trust You fully, and thank You for honouring such faith. Amen.
